name: limit_grid_does_not_count_as_a_row
why: ENTRY Z-C21.2, finding M6. ILinearPatternFeatureData~SkippedItemArray.html, Remarks: «For a bi-directional pattern: I = n2 * ( i - 1) + ( j - 1)». suppress_instance wrote the copy number as it was, as for a row: on a 3 x 2 grid «copy 3» removed the instance [2, 2] — the second of the second row — and answered succeeded, with a hole gone in a place nobody had named. A single number does not say a position on a grid: it is refused instead of guessing.
defect_caught: The grid of `grid_3x2` (six holes of 9) and «remove copy 3». On the old library a hole disappeared and the answer was succeeded; on the new one it is refused saying that it is a 3 x 2 grid, and the part keeps six holes.
_the_twin: `skip_the_second_copy`: the same operation on a ROW, where the copy number says a single position. It differs by «copies» (2 instead of 3); the pattern is named in the same way.

expect.tolerance_why: the diameter is read from CylinderParams
six holes of 9: the diameter is read from CylinderParams
480000 minus six times pi*4.5^2*20: the calculation has pi inside
